image_description: A close-up, low-angle view of a modern staircase featuring a metal bannister system. The handrail is a sleek, tubular metal bar running diagonally upwards. It is supported by thin vertical metal balusters and a mesh or grid-like infill panel. To the left, there is a darker wooden structure, possibly part of the stair frame or a secondary railing. The steps appear to be made of light-colored stone or concrete. The lighting is cool-toned, casting blueish shadows.
